bodyParagraphs.text: Every export shipment generates a fragmented set of documents that must agree with each other — and with the rules of customs, insurance, and banking.
That mismatch is what blocks refunds and voids claims.

Kanan Labs builds TradeWatch: validated, source-attributed evidence that gets your Shipping Bill and marine cargo documentation right before they cost you. We help exporters, their CHAs, and their brokers reduce compliance and claims risk — not paper over it.
Schedule a consultation to see how TradeWatch checks your export readiness.
